proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Occidental Set and Disclose Quantitative Short-, Medium- and Long-Term GHG Emissions Reduction Targets Consistent with the Paris Agreement
proposals.proponent: Follow This on behalf of Benta B.V.
proposals.topic_summary: Asks Occidental to set and publish quantitative short-, medium- and long-term GHG targets for Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions consistent with the Paris Agreement, and report annually on strategy and progress.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote "AGAINST" this proposal, if properly presented.
